label: Ability sources
description: Where a source unit's ability comes from. Tier budgets count innate abilities only.

terms.label: Upgrade
terms.description: Unlocked by a purchased upgrade or research.

terms.label: Loadout option
terms.description: Picked from a set of options when buying or fitting the unit; options in the same group exclude each other.

terms.label: Veterancy
terms.description: Gained when the unit ranks up.

terms.label: Commander power
terms.description: Granted by a faction-wide power or protocol, not by the unit itself.

tie_breaks.rule: Pick commander-power when the unlock comes from the side's own power menu or tree, picked during the match outside any building: a doctrine, protocols, a general's promotions, battlegroups, leader powers. What it costs does not matter. Pick upgrade when it is bought or researched at a building or on the unit, even when it then reaches every unit of that type.

Pick loadout when the player picks it from a set of choices when buying, spawning or fitting the unit. How a choice was first unlocked (score, rank, progression) does not matter. Pick upgrade when it is bought during the match and then stays.

Pick veterancy only when the ability itself first appears at a rank. An ability the unit has from the start is innate, even if ranks make it stronger. A cost per use, such as reinforcing or munitions, does not change the source.
